notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content: [p]“JI GUANG PIAN YU" upgraded to "JI GUANG STUDIO" this year. ScoutingSimulator also brings this newly designed studio to you.[/p][p][/p][p]What's new:[/p][p] - Add new location "JI GUANG STUDIO"[/p][p] - Refine some old models and textures.[/p][p] - Add a new camera type - Oldschool, a simple old optical viewfinder. Can be selected in options menu.[/p][p] - Adjusts key mapping for default camera - Morden, and frame line sets can be saved.[/p][p] - Add a selection to adjust motion blur amount.[/p][p] - Other improvements.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029674/6e5b2a684a6538dca4daf5cf55ff59154c574a33.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029674/fa687ffc46fb0abc4e4094d361924ac7a05c3afd.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029674/97bc10e1eea0b5f2b85541fb2aec21a21a298203.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029674/6b53e063a765064724d17c302a645d1bd298fed0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029674/ed4627503a32764a0d5db93fe114db9c024fe4cb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029674/e9fa25404c2c8cdd088b7f7a8875de51314a84a0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029674/7afc41564128928e7e587bbe9368748915bb5ff2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029674/810be4f7dece270b1c1ad0325dacd105d64ef398.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029674/d084b01098ef6d68debfe64805fc77dc23001c02.jpg"][/img][/p]
